senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; יָעַד) [appointed meeting,] assembly, congregation; court; prayer meeting.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 12:3">Tosef. Snh. XII, 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:18">Ex. XXI, 18</cite>) <he>מה אגרוף הידוע לע׳ ילעדים וכ׳</he> as the fist (of the slayer) is ascertained before court and witnesses, so must the stone (weapon) be &c.; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 90b:9">B. Kam. 90ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 91a:13">ib. 91ᵃ</cite>.

Snh. I, 6 (ref. to Num. XXXV, 24, sq.) ע׳ שופטת וע׳ מצלת there must be a possibility of an incriminating assembly (of ten persons), and of a saving assembly, which makes twenty persons; ומנין לע׳ שהיא וכ׳ and where do we find an intimation that an ‘edah consists of ten?; Y. Ber. IV, 11ᶜ top; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. II, end, 53ᵈ; Koh. R. to IX, 9; Yalk. ib. 989 ע׳ קדושה the holy brotherhood.
